<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="pool" name="Organisation" processRef="inspection-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="inspection-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_inspector" name="Inspector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>input</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>press</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addInput</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_app" name="Inspection application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>typeGw</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ask</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>show</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>joinGw</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>evaluate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>moreGw</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addAsk</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_machine" name="Bottling machine">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>collect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Inspection begins" />
    <bpmn:task id="enter" name="Enter machine type and serial number" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="typeGw" name="Questions or buttons?" />
    <bpmn:task id="ask" name="Ask questions" />
    <bpmn:task id="input" name="Input values" />
    <bpmn:task id="press" name="Press buttons" />
    <bpmn:task id="collect" name="Collect values from machine" />
    <bpmn:task id="show" name="Show values" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="joinGw" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluate" name="Evaluate results" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="moreGw" name="Additional questions needed?" />
    <bpmn:task id="addAsk" name="Ask additional questions" />
    <bpmn:task id="addInput" name="Input values" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Inspection finished" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="enter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="enter" targetRef="typeGw" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="collect" targetRef="show" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="show" targetRef="joinGw" />
